notes: M12 stable-contract register. Lists every public, machine-readable contract this implementation emits or consumes, with its current version and the compatibility rule that governs a change. A version bump is mandatory for a breaking change; a contract listed here with 'frozen' is intended not to change within a major line. This is the machine-checkable half of the release packet's stability guarantee; it does NOT claim the whole system is finished or audited.

each run records repeated batch-latency and per-process peak-RSS samples, a 1 ms target-poll sampled live-child RSS series (with missed batches explicit), and a per-batch sum of child peak RSS as a conservative concurrent-memory upper bound, plus aggregate node/edge throughput, concurrency, success/truncation outcomes, and deterministic workload identity; the manifest also records logical and allocated bytes for a verified local content-addressed store workload; host measurements are observations, not capacity guarantees

rules: every public contract carries a version string that a reader can reject
